title: Smashed Cabbage and Mushroom Veggie Burgers
changes_from_base: Instead of beans and grains, shredded cabbage, sliced onion and torn mushrooms are bound with a chickpea flour batter, rested, then pressed flat in the pan and fried slowly until golden, in the style of okonomiyaki, and topped with melted Cheddar.
summary: A hefty combination of finely shredded cabbage and mushrooms bound together with a savoury chickpea and egg batter, crowned with melted cheese.

ingredients.item: medium onion, halved and thinly sliced
green cabbage, core removed, finely shredded
mixed mushrooms (such as shiitake, chestnut and king trumpet), tough stems removed, torn into bite-size pieces
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Beat 1 large egg with 115 g chickpea flour, 240 ml water, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 grated garlic clove in a large bowl until combined.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Toss 1 thinly sliced medium onion, 225 g finely shredded green cabbage, 225 g torn mixed mushrooms and 1 tbsp sesame seeds with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp ground black pepper, then add the batter and massage everything together with your hands.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cover the mixture and leave at room temperature for 30 min until the batter becomes wetter and binds together.

steps.title: Divide
steps.text: Split the mixture into 6 equal portions.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Warm 60 ml vegetable oil in a large cast-iron frying pan over medium-low.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Add 3 portions to the hot oil, press each one into a patty with a wide flat fish slice and cook undisturbed for 7-8 min until golden underneath, flip and cook for 5-7 min until golden and completely cooked through; move to a wire rack.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Wipe the pan, add the remaining 60 ml oil and cook the other 3 portions in the same way.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Lay a slice of Cheddar on each hot patty to melt, then serve in a toasted brioche bun with mayonnaise, sliced tomato, sweet pickle slices and soft lettuce leaves.

tips: Shred the cabbage finely so it softens quickly in the pan and the patties hold together when you press them flat.
Allow the batter to rest for the full 30 min to allow flavours to meld and the mixture to bind
Cook the patties undisturbed on the first side to develop a golden crust
Pickles and buns can contain mustard or sesame, so check the labels if that matters
storage: These patties are best served immediately after cooking. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
